remarks: Williamsburg Common 2nd Floor End-Unit Condo In Williamsville! This Bright, Spacious, Move-In Ready 2 Bedroom, 2 Bath Home Features Beautifully Maintained 3.25" Natural Red Oak Hardwood Floors Throughout. The Inviting Living Room Boasts A Cozy Fireplace And Sliding Glass Doors To A Private Balcony With A Kohler Awning — Perfect For Morning Coffee Or Evening Relaxation. A Large Dining Room Sits Just Off The Living Room, And The Kitchen Offers A Breakfast Bar, All Appliances, And A Stackable Washer/Dryer. The Primary Bedroom Includes An Ensuite Full Bath. A Second Bedroom And An Additional Full Bath Featuring A Tub/Shower. Private Basement Storage, A One-Car Attached Garage With Opener, Plus An Additional Assigned Parking Space In Front Of The Unit. Truly Move-In Ready! Located Close To Walking Trails, Dash's Market, Transit Retail Stores, Restaurants, Amherst Community Center, Amherst Town Library, NYS 90, NYS 290 And NYS Route 78 North South Travel. Beautiful Condo And Convenience Awaits Your Tour! Seller's Discretion on day and time of entertaining offers.
